AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

20. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
